sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到斩首，体内血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心思想要隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Casefile would like to thank the Queensland Police Homicide Investigation Unit, the White Ribbon Foundation,
sentences.zh: Casefile 感谢昆士兰州警方凶杀案调查组、白丝带基金会，

sentences.en: and the family of Leanne Lapham for their assistance and support in creating this episode and highlighting the issues raised.
sentences.zh: 以及琳恩·拉帕姆的家人在制作本期节目并强调相关议题时给予的协助与支持。

sentences.en: The names of several witnesses have been changed.
sentences.zh: 文中部分证人的姓名已作更改。

sentences.en: In 1979, American psychologist Dr. Lenore Walker developed the Cycle of Violence, a theory that explains the patterns of behaviour within an abusive relationship.
sentences.zh: 1979年，美国心理学家莱诺·沃克博士提出了“暴力循环”理论，该理论解释了虐待关系中行为模式的演变。

sentences.en: The cycle consists of three phases.
sentences.zh: 这一循环由三个阶段组成。

sentences.en: The first is tension building, as daily issues like employment, finances, children, illness, and misunderstandings cause pressures within a couple to increase.
sentences.zh: 第一阶段是紧张积聚期，日常琐事如工作、经济、子女、疾病和误解导致夫妻间的压力不断增加。

sentences.en: During this time, verbal, emotional, or financial abuse intensifies to a boiling point, where release is inevitable.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，言语、情感或经济上的虐待会加剧至临界点，爆发变得不可避免。

sentences.en: The cycle then enters the second phase, acute explosion.
sentences.zh: 随后，循环进入第二阶段：急性爆发期。

sentences.en: Abuse peaks as the abuser establishes their dominance through action.
sentences.zh: 当施虐者通过暴力行为确立其支配地位时，虐待达到顶峰。

sentences.en: Following this, they may express feelings of remorse or shame, perhaps fearing their partner may leave or report them to authorities.
sentences.zh: 此后，他们可能会表现出悔恨或羞愧，或许是担心伴侣会离开或向当局举报他们。

sentences.en: They try to justify their actions by blaming external factors before seeking forgiveness, sometimes threatening self-harm to gain sympathy.
sentences.zh: 他们试图通过归咎于外部因素来为自己的行为辩解，随后寻求原谅，有时甚至会以自残相威胁来博取同情。

sentences.en: It's during this final stage, known as the honeymoon, where the abuser promises to change and displays an unusual amount of love and affection.
sentences.zh: 在被称为“蜜月期”的最后阶段，施虐者会承诺改变，并表现出异乎寻常的爱意与关怀。

sentences.en: The survivor is distressed, hurt, confused, yet hopeful the relationship will improve if they give their partner another chance.
sentences.zh: 幸存者感到痛苦、受伤、困惑，但仍心存希望，认为如果再给伴侣一次机会，关系会有所好转。

sentences.en: The pair then enter a stage of denial, downplaying the severity or refusing to acknowledge the abuse, answering a period of harmony and intimacy.
sentences.zh: 随后，两人进入否认阶段，淡化虐待的严重性或拒绝承认虐待的存在，从而迎来一段和谐与亲密的时期。

sentences.en: This stage can be short-lived or long-lasting, before the cycle repeats itself.
sentences.zh: 这一阶段可能短暂也可能持久，随后循环便会再次开始。

sentences.en: Situated on North Queensland's Cassowary Coast is Innisfail, a township of approximately 10,000 residents surrounded by farmland and old-growth rainforests.
sentences.zh: 因尼斯费尔位于昆士兰州北部的卡索瓦里海岸，是一个拥有约一万名居民的城镇，四周环绕着农田和原始雨林。

sentences.en: Heavy rainfall, coupled with an average daytime temperature of around 30 degrees Celsius, keeps the area lush and green all year, supporting an agricultural industry of sugarcane,
sentences.zh: 强降雨加上年均约30摄氏度的日间气温，使该地区终年郁郁葱葱，支撑着以甘蔗、

sentences.en: bananas, and other tropical fruits.
sentences.zh: 香蕉和其他热带水果为主的农业产业。

sentences.en: By 2009, 29-year-old Leanne Maxine Lapham had relocated to Innisfail to be closer to her family.
sentences.zh: 2009年，29岁的琳恩·玛克辛·拉帕姆搬到了因尼斯费尔，以便离家人更近。

sentences.en: She shared an unbreakable bond with her mother, Kerry, although their personalities often clashed.
sentences.zh: 她与母亲克里之间有着牢不可破的纽带，尽管她们的性格经常发生冲突。

sentences.en: Kerry believed this had less to do with animosity and more to do with astrology.
sentences.zh: 克里认为这与敌意无关，更多是受占星术的影响。

sentences.en: Leanne's star sign was Pisces, sensitive, intuitive, creative, and emotionally driven.
sentences.zh: 琳恩的星座是双鱼座，敏感、直觉强、富有创造力且情感丰富。

sentences.en: Kerry was a Capricorn, confident, practical, hardworking, and determined.
sentences.zh: 克里是摩羯座，自信、务实、勤奋且意志坚定。

sentences.en: Leanne also had bipolar disorder.
sentences.zh: 琳恩还患有双相情感障碍。

sentences.en: Although her mood was unpredictable at times, Kerry remained a pillar of support, and the pair shared more good times than bad.
sentences.zh: 尽管她的情绪有时难以捉摸，但克里始终是她坚强的后盾，母女俩共享的快乐时光远多于痛苦。

sentences.en: Leanne was good fun.
sentences.zh: 琳恩是个很有趣的人。

sentences.en: Whenever she saw an opportunity to get a rise out of her mother, her mischievous side would come out.
sentences.zh: 每当她有机会捉弄母亲时，她调皮的一面就会显露出来。

sentences.en: During a shopping centre visit, Leanne started tap dancing, much to Kerry's embarrassment.
sentences.zh: 在一次逛商场时，琳恩跳起了踢踏舞，让克里感到非常尴尬。

sentences.en: Her mother's mortification only encouraged Leanne as a passerby asked,
sentences.zh: 母亲的窘迫反而让琳恩更加起劲，这时一位路人问道：

sentences.en: Isn't it lovely to see somebody so happy?
sentences.zh: “看到这么开心的人，难道不觉得美好吗？”

sentences.en: To which Leanne replied,
sentences.zh: 琳恩回答道：

sentences.en: I just love my mummy.
sentences.zh: “我就是爱我的妈咪。”

sentences.en: Joking they were running away from home, the two set out on a road trip, heading south with the windows down and music blaring.
sentences.zh: 两人开玩笑说要离家出走，于是踏上了一场公路旅行，摇下车窗，放着大声的音乐向南驶去。

sentences.en: Leanne was at the wheel when slippery conditions caused the vehicle to spin and hit a dirt mound on the roadside.
sentences.zh: 当时由琳恩开车，湿滑的路面导致车辆打滑，撞上了路边的土堆。

sentences.en: Leanne was hesitant to get back behind the wheel, so they checked into a caravan park for the night.
sentences.zh: 琳恩不敢再开车，于是她们在一家房车公园住了一晚。

sentences.en: Their assigned caravan was perched on a hilltop above a busy highway, prompting Leanne to taunt her mother with comments like,
sentences.zh: 她们分配到的房车停在繁忙公路上方的小山坡上，这让琳恩忍不住调侃母亲道：

sentences.en: Wouldn't it be horrible if we started rolling down the hill?
sentences.zh: “如果我们顺着山坡滚下去，那该多可怕啊？”

sentences.en: Although it could drive her mad, Kerry embraced Leanne's playful personality.
sentences.zh: 虽然琳恩的性格有时会让克里抓狂，但她依然包容女儿这种爱玩的天性。

sentences.en: In Innisfail, Leanne was staying between Kerry and her partner Frank's house and a detached room at the home of a family friend, 57-year-old Augie.
sentences.zh: 在因尼斯费尔，琳恩往返于克里和她伴侣弗兰克的家，以及家庭朋友——57岁的奥吉家中的一间独立房间。

sentences.en: Augie lived on a wrecking yard that serviced his business, Mundu towing.
sentences.zh: 奥吉住在一个报废车场里，那里也是他经营的“蒙杜拖车”公司的所在地。

sentences.en: Leanne was searching for somewhere more permanent while doing occasional bar work and tattooing.
sentences.zh: 琳恩在寻找更稳定的住所，同时偶尔做些酒吧工作和纹身。

sentences.en: She had several of her own, a jester on her right shoulder, a woodpecker on her stomach, several flowers and stars on her legs,
sentences.zh: 她自己身上也有好几处纹身：右肩上的小丑、腹部的啄木鸟、腿上的花朵和星星，

sentences.en: and the name of her daughter, who was currently living with her father, on her left wriSt.
sentences.zh: 以及左手腕上纹着她女儿的名字，孩子目前正与父亲住在一起。

sentences.en: Hoping to make a career of it, Leanne would practice her art on friends and family, including inking a flower on Kerry's right calf.
sentences.zh: 为了以此为业，琳恩常在亲友身上练习纹身技术，包括在克里的右小腿上纹了一朵花。

sentences.en: In early 2009, Leanne was at Kerry and Frank's house when Frank invited over one of his workmates, 36-year-old Graham Evans.
sentences.zh: 2009年初，琳恩在克里和弗兰克家时，弗兰克邀请了他的同事，36岁的格雷厄姆·埃文斯过来。

sentences.en: The former butcher turned labourer had recently moved to Queensland from New South Wales, settling in Innisfail where he worked as a self-employed painter.
sentences.zh: 这位从屠夫转行做劳工的男子刚从新南威尔士州搬到昆士兰，在因尼斯费尔定居，从事个体油漆工的工作。

sentences.en: When he laid eyes on Leanne, Evans felt an immediate attraction and wasn't shy telling Kerry his feelings.
sentences.zh: 当他第一眼看到琳恩时，埃文斯便产生了强烈的好感，并毫不避讳地向克里表达了自己的心意。

sentences.en: Protective of Leanne, she warned him that it was her daughter he was talking about.
sentences.zh: 作为母亲，克里很保护琳恩，她警告埃文斯说，他谈论的可是她的女儿。

sentences.en: Evans excused himself to use the bathroom, but went to speak with Leanne instead, inviting her on a date that evening.
sentences.zh: 埃文斯借口去洗手间，却转而去和琳恩搭话，并邀请她当晚约会。

sentences.en: Evans maintained a level of stability and charm that separated him from other men around town, and Leanne returned from their date smitten.
sentences.zh: 埃文斯表现出的稳定感和魅力让他与镇上的其他男人不同，琳恩约会回来后便坠入了爱河。

sentences.en: Kerry cautioned her to take things slow, but the two quickly became a couple.
sentences.zh: 克里提醒她要慢慢来，但两人很快就确立了恋爱关系。

sentences.en: Theirs was a rocky relationship from the outset, with the erratic Evans often lashing out at Leanne.
sentences.zh: 他们的关系从一开始就充满波折，喜怒无常的埃文斯经常对琳恩发火。

sentences.en: Kerry felt it wasn't going to work, but Leanne excused his behaviour by saying,
sentences.zh: 克里觉得这段关系不会长久，但琳恩却为他的行为开脱道：

sentences.en: Mum, he's really nice.
sentences.zh: “妈，他其实人很好。”

sentences.en: He just gets angry.
sentences.zh: “他只是容易生气。”

sentences.en: The pair fluctuated between contentment and disharmony, with Leanne's threats to leave, causing Evans to beg for forgiveness, declare his love, and promise to treat her better.
sentences.zh: 两人的关系在满足与不和之间摇摆，琳恩威胁要离开时，埃文斯便会乞求原谅，宣称爱她，并承诺会善待她。

sentences.en: In September 2009, Leanne fell pregnant.
sentences.zh: 2009年9月，琳恩怀孕了。

sentences.en: Determined to raise her child in a stable, two-parent household, she believed Evans when he expressed joy and eagerness at starting a family.
sentences.zh: 她决心在稳定、双亲健全的家庭中抚养孩子，因此当埃文斯表现出组建家庭的喜悦和渴望时，她选择了相信他。

sentences.en: Yet, his behaviour remained violent and unpredictable, causing Leanne to break things off, only to resume their relationship when Evans expressed remorse.
sentences.zh: 然而，他的行为依然暴力且难以预测，导致琳恩多次提出分手，但每当埃文斯表现出悔意时，两人又会复合。

sentences.en: In early 2010, when Leanne was heavily pregnant, she and Evans travelled 16 kilometres north to camp at Ella Bay.
sentences.zh: 2010年初，琳恩已身怀六甲，她和埃文斯驱车向北16公里，前往埃拉湾露营。

sentences.en: An argument broke out and Evans slapped Leanne, snatched her handbag, and pushed her out of the car.
sentences.zh: 争吵中，埃文斯打了琳恩一巴掌，抢走她的手提包，并将她推下车。

sentences.en: He slammed her legs in the door before driving away.
sentences.zh: 他用力关上车门夹伤了她的腿，然后开车离去。

sentences.en: Severely bruised on both legs, face, and arms, Leanne walked to a payphone and called her mother in tears.
sentences.zh: 琳恩的双腿、脸部和手臂多处淤青，她走到公用电话亭，哭着给母亲打了电话。

sentences.en: A taxi was ordered to pick her up.
sentences.zh: 随后叫了一辆出租车去接她。

sentences.en: Kerry knew Evans was verbally abusive and called her daughter names, but Leanne assured everything was fine.
sentences.zh: 克里知道埃文斯有言语虐待倾向，经常辱骂女儿，但琳恩坚称一切都好。

sentences.en: When she saw the injuries Evans caused, Kerry encouraged Leanne to file a police report.
sentences.zh: 当看到埃文斯造成的伤痕时，克里鼓励琳恩报警。

sentences.en: And she obtained a medical certificate to corroborate it.
sentences.zh: 她还为此开具了医疗证明以作佐证。

sentences.en: On March 15, Leanne was scheduled to appear at the Innisfail Magistrates Court to apply for a domestic violence order against Evans, who had no prior criminal record,
sentences.zh: 3月15日，琳恩原定前往因尼斯费尔地方法院申请针对埃文斯的家庭暴力禁制令，此前埃文斯并无犯罪记录，

sentences.en: citing intimidation, harassment, and verbal and physical threats.
sentences.zh: 申请理由包括恐吓、骚扰以及言语和身体威胁。

sentences.en: However, she had to leave before the application was filed to attend an antenatal class.
sentences.zh: 然而，为了参加产前课程，她在申请提交前不得不先行离开。

sentences.en: The order was adjourned until April 13.
sentences.zh: 禁制令的审理被推迟到了4月13日。

sentences.en: On March 21, Leanne sent a text message to a long-time friend, Matt, who lived in Brisbane.
sentences.zh: 3月21日，琳恩给住在布里斯班的老友马特发了一条短信。

sentences.en: She was fed up with Innisfail and had plans to leave town if the judge didn't issue the domestic violence order against Evans.
sentences.zh: 她对因尼斯费尔感到厌倦，并计划如果法官不批准针对埃文斯的禁制令，她就离开这个小镇。

sentences.en: He had recently threatened to steal the baby from her, or failing that, take it by force.
sentences.zh: 埃文斯最近威胁要从她身边偷走孩子，如果不行，就强行抢走。

sentences.en: She detailed how Evans showed up unannounced at her mother's house and refused to leave.
sentences.zh: 她详细描述了埃文斯如何不请自来地出现在她母亲家，并拒绝离开。

sentences.en: He verbally abused Leanne, causing her to lose her temper.
sentences.zh: 他辱骂琳恩，导致她大发雷霆。

sentences.en: She wrote to Matt,
sentences.zh: 她在给马特的信中写道：

sentences.en: The Innisfail Department of Communities, Child Safety, and Disability Services contacted Leanne on March 22, amidst concerns for her unborn child's welfare.
sentences.zh: 3月22日，因尼斯费尔社区、儿童安全与残疾服务部联系了琳恩，表达了对她未出生孩子福利的担忧。

sentences.en: Leanne reported that her relationship with Evans had ended.
sentences.zh: 琳恩告知他们，她与埃文斯的关系已经结束。

sentences.en: She also intended to obtain the domestic violence order, referencing the threats he'd made.
sentences.zh: 她还打算申请家庭暴力禁制令，并提到了他曾发出的威胁。

sentences.en: The department then contacted Graham Evans, who said that he had no intention of resuming the relationship, citing Leanne's bipolar disorder and their constant arguing.
sentences.zh: 该部门随后联系了格雷厄姆·埃文斯，他表示无意复合，并提到了琳恩的双相情感障碍和他们不断的争吵。

sentences.en: Kerry didn't see Evans for a few weeks and assumed the domestic violence order had been filed and the relationship was over.
sentences.zh: 克里有几周没见到埃文斯，以为禁制令已经生效，这段关系也已经结束。

sentences.en: On March 24, 2010, Leanne gave birth to a boy named Bradley James Lapham.
sentences.zh: 2010年3月24日，琳恩生下了一个男孩，取名布拉德利·詹姆斯·拉帕姆。
zh_words: 取名布拉德利·詹姆斯·拉帕姆

sentences.en: Evans visited them in hospital, promising to change and provide for his family.
sentences.zh: 埃文斯去医院探望了他们，承诺会改变并承担起养家的责任。

sentences.en: Leanne was reluctant, but agreed to get back together if he delivered on his promises.
sentences.zh: 琳恩虽然心存疑虑，但还是同意如果他能兑现承诺，就和他复合。

sentences.en: When her mother questioned Leanne's decision, she responded that she loved Evans and wanted to make things work for Bradley.
sentences.zh: 当母亲质疑琳恩的决定时，她回答说她爱埃文斯，想为了布拉德利让这段关系好转。

sentences.en: The couple found an ideal family home, a spacious three-bedroom house surrounded by greenery 22 kilometres south of Innisfail, but it wasn't available until later in the month.
sentences.zh: 这对情侣找到了一处理想的家庭住所，那是一栋宽敞的三居室房子，四周绿树环绕，位于因尼斯费尔以南22公里处，但要到月底才能入住。

sentences.en: Evans sent Leanne a text, promising to fund a motel room for them in the meantime, writing,
sentences.zh: 埃文斯给琳恩发了一条短信，承诺在此期间资助他们住汽车旅馆，写道：

sentences.en: The next morning, he secured a one-week stay at the Riverside Motel in the town centre, where he and Leanne had stayed on prior occasions, and on April 13, the trio settled in.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，他在市中心的河畔汽车旅馆订了一周的房间，他和琳恩之前曾住过那里。4月13日，三人搬了进去。

sentences.en: Leanne failed to appear in court to complete her domestic violence order against Evans, seemingly eager to start afresh.
sentences.zh: 琳恩没有出庭完成针对埃文斯的家庭暴力禁制令申请，似乎渴望重新开始。

sentences.en: But this honeymoon period was only temporary.
sentences.zh: 但这段蜜月期只是暂时的。

sentences.en: By the evening of April 15, the pair were fighting again.
sentences.zh: 到了4月15日晚上，两人又开始争吵。

sentences.en: Evans was failing to live up to his promises, arriving home late, drinking too much, and rumours had spread of his alleged infidelity.
sentences.zh: 埃文斯没能履行承诺，经常晚归，酗酒，而且还有关于他出轨的传言。

sentences.en: He urged Leanne to be strong and persevere for Bradley's sake.
sentences.zh: 他催促琳恩要坚强，为了布拉德利坚持下去。

sentences.en: At 10am on Monday April 19, Evans dropped Leanne and Bradley at Kerry's house, a three-minute drive from the Riverside Motel.
sentences.zh: 4月19日星期一上午10点，埃文斯把琳恩和布拉德利送到克里家，那里距离河畔汽车旅馆只有三分钟车程。

sentences.en: Leanne and Kerry ran some errands in town, including a visit to Bendigo Bank, where Leanne withdrew $100.
sentences.zh: 琳恩和克里在镇上办了一些事，包括去本迪戈银行，琳恩取了100美元。

sentences.en: They entered the Cole supermarket, where Leanne purchased food for dinner.
sentences.zh: 她们走进科尔超市，琳恩买了晚餐的食材。

sentences.en: She sent Evans a text suggesting she cook a seafood basket or creamy sauce, and reminded him to pick her up for a three o'clock post-pernatal appointment.
sentences.zh: 她给埃文斯发了一条短信，建议做海鲜拼盘或奶油酱意面，并提醒他三点钟来接她去参加产后检查。

sentences.en: He responded,
sentences.zh: 他回复道：

sentences.en: Sounds good, hun.
sentences.zh: “听起来不错，亲爱的。”

sentences.en: See you then.
sentences.zh: “到时候见。”

sentences.en: Evans arrived after 3pm, and Leanne, irritated by his tardiness, silently climbed into his white 1994 Holden Rodeo ute, and the pair took off.
sentences.zh: 埃文斯三点多才到，琳恩对他迟到感到恼火，一言不发地坐进了他那辆白色的1994年款霍顿Rodeo皮卡车，两人随即离开。

sentences.en: At 2.30pm the next day, Evans' friend Sam arrived home to find Evans and baby Bradley at his house.
sentences.zh: 第二天下午2点30分，埃文斯的朋友萨姆回到家，发现埃文斯和婴儿布拉德利在他家里。

sentences.en: Evans' ute was packed full of gear, and he asked to stay the night, saying,
sentences.zh: 埃文斯的皮卡车里塞满了装备，他请求留宿一晚，说道：

sentences.en: She's left me with the baby and gone off.
sentences.zh: “她把孩子留给我，自己跑了。”

sentences.en: He explained that the night before, Leanne was angry at him for being late and slapped a beer out of his hand, then stormed out of their motel room.
sentences.zh: 他解释说，前一天晚上，琳恩因为他迟到而生气，打掉了他手中的啤酒，然后冲出了汽车旅馆的房间。

sentences.en: Evans assumed she was blowing off steam and would return later, but she never did.
sentences.zh: 埃文斯以为她只是在发泄情绪，稍后会回来，但她再也没有出现。

sentences.en: Two days later, on April 22, Leanne's sister received a phone call from Evans.
sentences.zh: 两天后的4月22日，琳恩的姐姐接到了埃文斯的电话。

sentences.en: He said Leanne had gone to Cairns, a coastal city 80km north of Innisfail, to visit a friend who had just given birth, and texted him saying she would be home later that evening.
sentences.zh: 他说琳恩去了凯恩斯（因尼斯费尔以北80公里的沿海城市），去探望一位刚生完孩子的朋友，并给他发短信说当晚会回家。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Kerry had noticed that Leanne wasn't responding to texts or answering calls.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，克里注意到琳恩既不回短信也不接电话。

sentences.en: She phoned Evans, who claimed Leanne had her mobile phone with her in Cairns, but he hadn't heard from her at all.
sentences.zh: 她打电话给埃文斯，埃文斯声称琳恩在凯恩斯时带着手机，但他一直没收到她的消息。

sentences.en: While it wasn't unusual for her daughter to travel to visit friends,
sentences.zh: 虽然女儿去探望朋友并不罕见，

sentences.en: Kerry knew Leanne would not elect to leave her newborn in the care of Graham Evans.
sentences.zh: 但克里知道，琳恩绝不会选择把新生儿交给格雷厄姆·埃文斯照顾。

sentences.en: Over the following days, Evans spoke to friends about Leanne's departure, telling some she would return within the week, and others that she wasn't coming back at all.
sentences.zh: 接下来的几天里，埃文斯向朋友们谈起琳恩的离开，对一些人说她一周内就会回来，对另一些人则说她再也不会回来了。

sentences.en: On April 28, Kerry arrived to Innisfail Police Station to file a missing persons report.
sentences.zh: 4月28日，克里来到因尼斯费尔警察局报案失踪。

sentences.en: To the best of her knowledge, Leanne didn't owe anyone money and was well-liked within her social circle.
sentences.zh: 据她所知，琳恩没有欠任何人钱，在社交圈里也很受欢迎。

sentences.en: She detailed Graham Evans' abusive behaviour, including an incident on Leanne's birthday when he threw a hot drink at her, burning her skin.
sentences.zh: 她详细描述了格雷厄姆·埃文斯的虐待行为，包括在琳恩生日那天，他向她泼热饮，烫伤了她的皮肤。

sentences.en: Bank records revealed Leanne hadn't accessed her account since the day she allegedly left the motel alone.
sentences.zh: 银行记录显示，自琳恩据称独自离开汽车旅馆那天起，她就再也没有使用过账户。

sentences.en: Graham Evans provided a statement to police in which he attested that he had not heard from Leanne since April 19 and had no knowledge of her current whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆·埃文斯向警方提供了陈述，声称自4月19日以来就没收到过琳恩的消息，也不知道她现在的下落。

sentences.en: He claimed she had gone to the supermarket that night to get more dinner ingredients and returned a short time later with a white plastic bag tucked in her brown handbag.
sentences.zh: 他声称那天晚上她去超市买晚餐食材，不久后就回来了，棕色手提包里装着一个白色塑料袋。

sentences.en: Between 7.30 and 8pm, Leanne grabbed her handbag and walked out the door without saying a word.
sentences.zh: 晚上7点半到8点之间，琳恩抓起手提包，一言不发地走出了门。

sentences.en: She hadn't reappeared by the next day and wasn't responding to messages.
sentences.zh: 第二天她没有再出现，也没有回复信息。

sentences.en: Despite having extended their stay for one more night, Evans checked out of the motel with Bradley
sentences.zh: 尽管已经续住了一晚，埃文斯还是带着布拉德利退了房，

sentences.en: and went to stay at his friend Sam's house, convinced Leanne had left him for good.
sentences.zh: 并去朋友萨姆家住下，坚信琳恩已经彻底离开了他。

sentences.en: Evans admitted he and Leanne had a volatile relationship, but denied the Ella Bay car door incident, explaining,
sentences.zh: 埃文斯承认他和琳恩的关系不稳定，但否认了埃拉湾车门事件，解释道：

sentences.en: He described Leanne as headstrong and that her bipolar disorder caused her to become easily upset and moody.
sentences.zh: 他形容琳恩性格倔强，双相情感障碍导致她容易心烦意乱、情绪化。

sentences.en: In the week leading up to her disappearance, Leanne threatened to end their relationship and to leave town, but the pair managed to patch things up.
sentences.zh: 在失踪前的一周里，琳恩曾威胁要结束关系并离开小镇，但两人设法修复了关系。

sentences.en: Evans claimed that she, quote, would always go and come back.
sentences.zh: 埃文斯声称她“总是会走，然后又回来”。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: Casefile稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持Casefile继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Evans handed his mobile phone to police, with text messages between him and Leanne displaying a clear cycle.
sentences.zh: 埃文斯将手机交给警方，他和琳恩之间的短信记录显示了一个清晰的循环。

sentences.en: Conversations switched between affectionate banter and chit-chat before an argument would take place.
sentences.zh: 对话在亲昵的调侃和闲聊之间切换，随后便会发生争吵。

sentences.en: Leanne would express her disappointment with Evans and give him the opportunity to end the relationship, but he begged her to stay.
sentences.zh: 琳恩会表达对埃文斯的失望，并给他结束关系的机会，但他却乞求她留下。

sentences.en: On April 10, Evans texted Leanne how much he loved her and was thankful for the chance to make things right.
sentences.zh: 4月10日，埃文斯给琳恩发短信说他有多爱她，并感谢她给了他弥补的机会。

sentences.en: The next night, he wrote,
sentences.zh: 第二天晚上，他写道：

sentences.en: Love you with all my heart.
sentences.zh: “全心全意地爱你。”

sentences.en: I am so mad with myself for letting it end up like this.
sentences.zh: “我对自己让事情变成这样感到非常生气。”

sentences.en: I can make it right, and that's what this man will do, hon.
sentences.zh: “我可以弥补这一切，这就是这个男人会做的，亲爱的。”

sentences.en: I swear.
sentences.zh: “我发誓。”

sentences.en: By April 17, tensions escalated once more.
sentences.zh: 到了4月17日，紧张局势再次升级。

sentences.en: Leanne told Evans she had booked a flight and was leaving for good, as he pleaded with her to reconsider.
sentences.zh: 琳恩告诉埃文斯她已经订了机票，打算彻底离开，而他则恳求她重新考虑。

sentences.en: Leanne insisted they were better off apart, and Evans responded by swearing on their son's life that he would never snap at her again, asking her to let him love her.
sentences.zh: 莉安坚持认为他们分开会更好，而埃文斯则以他们儿子的性命起誓，保证再也不会对她发火，并请求她让他继续爱她。

sentences.en: By April 19, things seemed to have improved as they texted dinner plans throughout the afternoon until they were back together at the motel room.
sentences.zh: 到了4月19日，情况似乎有所好转，整个下午他们都在互发短信商量晚餐计划，直到他们在汽车旅馆的房间里重聚。

sentences.en: There was silence until 10.35pm when Leanne's mobile received a text from Evans letting her know that he had fed the baby and gone to sleep.
sentences.zh: 房间里一片寂静，直到晚上10点35分，莉安的手机收到埃文斯发来的一条短信，告诉她他已经喂过孩子并睡下了。

sentences.en: She did not reply.
sentences.zh: 她没有回复。

sentences.en: Over the following days of Leanne's disappearance, Evans texted her to get in touch, offering to pick her up wherever she had gone and sending her his love.
sentences.zh: 在莉安失踪后的几天里，埃文斯发短信让她联系自己，提出无论她去了哪里都可以去接她，并向她表达爱意。

sentences.en: She did not respond.
sentences.zh: 她没有回应。

sentences.en: Detectives were unconvinced Leanne would willingly leave her four-week-old son and were immediately suspicious about Evans.
sentences.zh: 侦探们不相信莉安会自愿抛下她四周大的儿子离开，并立即对埃文斯产生了怀疑。

sentences.en: A search of the couple's three-bedroom house that they planned to move into and their former room at the Riverside Motel uncovered no signs of foul play.
sentences.zh: 警方搜查了这对夫妇计划搬入的三居室住宅以及他们之前在河畔汽车旅馆住过的房间，但没有发现任何犯罪迹象。

sentences.en: The motel manager revealed that during a previous stay in 2009, Leanne and Evans were heard arguing, followed by smashing glass.
sentences.zh: 汽车旅馆经理透露，在2009年他们之前入住期间，曾听到莉安和埃文斯发生争吵，随后传来了玻璃破碎的声音。

sentences.en: Leanne called out for help, but the fight dissipated soon after.
sentences.zh: 莉安曾呼救，但争吵很快就平息了。

sentences.en: During their recent motel booking in mid-April,
sentences.zh: 在他们最近于4月中旬预订汽车旅馆期间，

sentences.en: Evans approached the manager at around lunchtime on the 19th, requesting to stay an extra week.
sentences.zh: 埃文斯在19日午餐时间左右找到经理，要求多住一周。

sentences.en: Citing their disruptive behaviour, the manager only agreed to an additional day and at around 4.30pm, sighted Leanne smoking outside.
sentences.zh: 由于他们之前的扰民行为，经理只同意让他们多住一天，并在下午4点30分左右看到莉安在外面抽烟。

sentences.en: That was the last he saw of her, and there had been no reports of disputes or suspicious activity immediately prior or after her disappearance.
sentences.zh: 那是他最后一次见到她，而且在她失踪前后，没有任何关于争吵或可疑活动的报告。

sentences.en: At 8am the next morning, the manager noticed Evans' ute wasn't in the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上8点，经理注意到埃文斯的皮卡车不在停车场。

sentences.en: It reappeared at around 1pm, parked near the administration office with Evans loading items into the back tray.
sentences.zh: 下午1点左右，车子又出现了，停在行政办公室附近，埃文斯正在往后车厢装东西。

sentences.en: The manager recalled seeing a second person helping, but couldn't be sure.
sentences.zh: 经理记得看到有第二个人在帮忙，但不能确定。

sentences.en: Evans then told reception the family would be moving elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 随后埃文斯告诉前台，他们一家要搬到别处去。

sentences.en: A cleaner attended to the vacant room the following day, where she noticed two bed pillows were missing, along with their slips and protectors.
sentences.zh: 第二天，一名清洁工去打扫那间空房，她注意到两个枕头不见了，枕套和枕芯保护套也不见了。

sentences.en: Two fresh pillows were found in a cupboard, but were of a completely different brand.
sentences.zh: 柜子里虽然找到了两个新枕头，但品牌完全不同。

sentences.en: CCTV footage from April 19 showed Leanne visit the supermarket at 6.40pm, with transaction records listing her cash purchase of cream, mushrooms and onions.
sentences.zh: 4月19日的监控录像显示，莉安在晚上6点40分去了超市，交易记录显示她用现金购买了奶油、蘑菇和洋葱。

sentences.en: Three minutes later, she was filmed heading back to the Riverside Motel, with the Imperial tavern camera across the street recording her return at 6.51pm.
sentences.zh: 三分钟后，她被拍到返回河畔汽车旅馆，街对面的帝国酒馆摄像头记录下她在6点51分回到那里。

sentences.en: This camera pointed towards the road and captured a portion of the motel yard.
sentences.zh: 这个摄像头对着马路，拍到了汽车旅馆院子的一部分。

sentences.en: Silhouettes of several figures were recorded coming and going, but Leanne was not sighted leaving the Riverside Motel.
sentences.zh: 监控记录下几个身影进进出出，但没有看到莉安离开河畔汽车旅馆。

sentences.en: This didn't necessarily prove anything, as the footage only captured the left side of the motel, whereas the couple were staying in a unit on the right.
sentences.zh: 这并不一定能证明什么，因为监控只拍到了汽车旅馆的左侧，而这对夫妇住的单元在右侧。

sentences.en: Furthermore, the cameras were shut down at 11pm while the system was backed up overnight, resuming at approximately 9 the next morning.
sentences.zh: 此外，摄像头在晚上11点关闭以进行系统夜间备份，直到第二天早上9点左右才恢复。

sentences.en: Leanne's friends and acquaintances provided further insight into her abusive relationship with Evans, with witnesses reporting that in the past he dragged
sentences.zh: 莉安的朋友和熟人提供了更多关于她与埃文斯虐待关系的信息，证人报告称过去他曾

sentences.en: her screaming by her hair and threatened to slit her throat.
sentences.zh: 揪着她的头发把她拖走，并威胁要割开她的喉咙。

sentences.en: Leanne had also been seen with red marks around her neck, telling others Evans had choked her unconscious.
sentences.zh: 莉安也曾被看到脖子上有红印，她告诉别人是埃文斯把她掐晕了。

sentences.en: This was of particular interest to detectives, as statistics showed women who are non-fatally strangled by their domestic partners are seven times more likely to be murdered.
sentences.zh: 这一点引起了侦探们的特别关注，因为统计数据显示，遭受伴侣非致命性勒颈的女性，被谋杀的可能性是普通人的七倍。

sentences.en: Investigators spoke with a former girlfriend of
sentences.zh: 调查人员与埃文斯的一位前女友进行了交谈，

sentences.en: Evans, who explained their relationship started positively, with friends predicting it was built to laSt.
sentences.zh: 她解释说他们的关系开始时很美好，朋友们都认为他们能长久。

sentences.en: She described Evans at the outset as a normal country guy and a dependable provider, who offered financial assistance to friends strapped for cash.
sentences.zh: 她形容刚开始时的埃文斯是个正常的乡村小伙，是个可靠的供养者，还会为手头紧的朋友提供经济援助。

sentences.en: Then, one afternoon, as she drove and intoxicated Evans home, he punched her for the first time.
sentences.zh: 后来，一天下午，当她开车送喝醉的埃文斯回家时，他第一次打了她。

sentences.en: She broke up with him, only to relent to his begs for forgiveness and reunite three weeks later.
sentences.zh: 她和他分手了，但最终还是心软，在他苦苦哀求下，三周后又复合了。

sentences.en: The abuse escalated and peaked when she lost their child from an ectopic pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 虐待行为不断升级，并在她因宫外孕失去孩子时达到了顶峰。

sentences.en: Evans spiralled afterwards, wrapping his hands around her neck and threatening to kill her.
sentences.zh: 此后埃文斯陷入疯狂，双手掐住她的脖子并威胁要杀了她。

sentences.en: She took his threats seriously, as Evans was a gun enthusiast and owned several firearMs.
sentences.zh: 她认真对待了他的威胁，因为埃文斯是个枪支爱好者，拥有几把枪。

sentences.en: In 2001, she left all her belongings and fled to a friend's house, marking the end of her five-year ordeal.
sentences.zh: 2001年，她抛下所有财物逃到朋友家，结束了她五年的苦难。

sentences.en: Evans continued to harass and stalk her until he moved to Queensland in 2007.
sentences.zh: 埃文斯继续骚扰和跟踪她，直到2007年他搬到昆士兰州。

sentences.en: A former cleaner who serviced Evans home told investigators of three threatening incidents in August and September of 2002.
sentences.zh: 一位曾为埃文斯家提供服务的清洁工告诉调查人员，2002年8月和9月发生了三起威胁事件。

sentences.en: She reported him to the police after she found him waiting in his car outside her home, despite having never told him where she lived.
sentences.zh: 她在自己家门外发现埃文斯坐在车里等着她，尽管她从未告诉过他自己住在哪里，于是她报了警。

sentences.en: As she never made a formal statement, she was unaware if any action was taken.
sentences.zh: 由于她从未正式录口供，她不知道警方是否采取了行动。

sentences.en: Domestic violence orders do not appear on the respondent's criminal record unless they had disobeyed, meaning this information was absent from Evans' own record.
sentences.zh: 家庭暴力禁令除非被违反，否则不会出现在被申请人的犯罪记录中，这意味着这些信息在埃文斯自己的记录中是缺失的。

sentences.en: When questioned about Evans' demeanour the day after Leanne disappeared, his friend Sam failed to notice anything unusual.
sentences.zh: 当被问及莉安失踪后第二天埃文斯的表现时，他的朋友萨姆没有发现任何异常。

sentences.en: Although, Evans was in possession of a brown handbag adorned with diamond-shaped patterns.
sentences.zh: 不过，埃文斯当时拿着一个装饰有菱形图案的棕色手提包。

sentences.en: Sam was able to describe the bag in intricate detail that far exceeded the rudimentary description circulating in the media, proving he had seen it in person.
sentences.zh: 萨姆能够详细描述这个包，其细节远超媒体流传的粗略描述，这证明他亲眼见过。

sentences.en: Electronic surveillance was later placed on Evans' mobile phone.
sentences.zh: 后来，埃文斯的手机被安装了电子监控。

sentences.en: It recorded a conversation between him and Sam, with Evans conceding he may have had Leanne's handbag with him when he visited Sam's home on April 20.
sentences.zh: 监控记录了他和萨姆之间的一段对话，埃文斯承认4月20日他去萨姆家时，可能带着莉安的手提包。

sentences.en: As the investigation progressed, Kerry was unable to shake the feeling that Evans knew more about her daughter's disappearance than he was letting on.
sentences.zh: 随着调查的深入，克里无法摆脱一种感觉，那就是埃文斯对她女儿的失踪知道得比他透露的要多。

sentences.en: He looked her in her eyes and swore he had no idea where Leanne had gone.
sentences.zh: 他直视她的眼睛，发誓他根本不知道莉安去了哪里。

sentences.en: Kerry, quote,
sentences.zh: 克里说，

sentences.en: I just had that feeling, that gut feeling.
sentences.zh: 我当时就是有那种感觉，那种直觉。

sentences.en: I thought, he knows something.
sentences.zh: 我想，他肯定知道些什么。

sentences.en: I know he knows something.
sentences.zh: 我知道他知道些什么。

sentences.en: But nobody could prove anything.
sentences.zh: 但没人能证明什么。

sentences.en: After having been made aware that CCTV footage was available from the
sentences.zh: 在得知帝国酒馆有监控录像后，

sentences.en: Imperial Tavern, Graham Evans agreed to participate in a formal police interview.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆·埃文斯同意配合进行正式的警方问话。

sentences.en: His story remained the same, except for one detail.
sentences.zh: 他的说法保持不变，只有一个细节除外。

sentences.en: He stated he arose before dawn and drove to Kerry's house to see if
sentences.zh: 他声称自己在黎明前起床，开车去克里家看看

sentences.en: Leanne was there, but the lights were off so he left without knocking on the door.
